D-B (2026-07-22 F1 velocity overhaul, Stage 2.1) — MEASURED near-high tolerance: p90 of the QQQ trailing-252d distFraction distribution (distFraction = qClose / max(qClose over the trailing SLOW_HIGH_WINDOW=252 closes INCLUDING today; ∈ (0,1], →1 = at the high; exactly as src/slow.ts:291-294 computes it). Each day with ≥252 closes contributes one distFraction; the tolerance is np.quantile(dists, 0.90) (linear/type-7, matching src/slow.ts `quantile`), so QQQ sits at/above it only ~10% of days = genuinely near the high. Source: RAW closes from scripts/backtest/data/qqq.csv (distFraction is a ratio, split/div adjustment cancels — see derive.ts). Provisional: measured, NOT optimized.
